Ashish Kumar Gupta

Site Reliability Engineer – Senior CONSULTANT

Bengaluru | 08376928303 | studs0905@gmail.com | 

https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashish-kumar-gupta-5b419831/

Summary

Seasoned Site Reliability Engineer with extensive experience in managing and optimizing IT infrastructure, automating deployment processes, and leading cross-functional teams. Proficient in utilizing DevOps tools and automation to enhance system reliability and operational efficiency. Known for quick learning and adaptability to new technologies, with a focus on continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Skills

DevOps & Automation Jenkins Pipeline with multiple Plugins Ansible (v2.2.0.0, v2.10) Docker/Docker Compose Kubernetes Administration Bitbucket Repository JFrog Artifactory Azure DevOps Server( Pipeline, WhiteBoard, GitRepo ) Scripting & Programming Bash Python YAML Infrastructure Management System Architecture High Availability Disaster Recovery Third-Party Applications Admin Denodo Oracle Hyperion Collibra Automation Anywhere Confluent Kafka Middleware Administration Weblogic 11g/12c Nginx, Apache, OHS Monitoring & Logging Splunk (v6.5.3.1) Opera Bosun Rules Custom Solutions Thousand Eye Graphana Version Control & Repositories Bitbucket JFrog Artifactory Azure Git Repo CI/CD Jenkins Azure DevOps Incident Management: ServiceNow JIRA Troubleshooting & Security System Troubleshooting Security Implementation Leadership & Collaboration Team Leadership Technical Guidance Cross-functional Collaboration Learning & Adaptability Quick learner, ability to adapt to new cloud environments (e.g., Azure)

Experience

09/2016 to Current System Engineer - Senior Consultant VISA Inc. － Bengaluru, IN Lead and Manage a Team of Site Reliability Engineers. Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance, individual contribution and support to a team of highly motivated engineers across the APAC region, ensuring high-quality deliverables. Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, and other engineers to align technical efforts with business goals and drive successful outcomes. Operational Excellence: Foster a culture of operational excellence by implementing best practices, optimizing processes, and driving continuous improvement. Team Development: Cultivate a positive and collaborative team culture that promotes teamwork, knowledge sharing, and professional growth. Technology Innovation: Stay abreast of emerging technologies and recommend tools and frameworks to enhance efficiency, productivity, and reliability. Project Delivery: Ensure successful delivery of technical milestones and projects within defined timelines, while maintaining high standards of quality. Key Responsibilities: Lead and drive the APAC team of Site Reliability Engineers (SRE) at Visa to provide Infrastructure support and optimization of Web, App, Middleware, and Integration technologies in Linux. Designing the Architecture and Setting up the secure, highly available and high performing application infrastructure in on-prem as well as on public cloud like Azure. Implemented the Hybrid design as well with Data within the VISA Network and application on Azure cloud. Setting up the application infrastructure for third-party applications like Denodo 6.0/7.0/8.0, Oracle Hyperion(11.1.2.4/11.2.8/11.2.15), confluent Kafka streaming services, Automation Anywhere 360 etc and  also for custom application with microservice architecture like Visa University, Visa Insite3.0 etc. Leveraging the Kubernetes(v1.30.1.1) infrastructure with varied objects like deployments, services, replica sets, ingress, roles and cluster Bindings etc for managing the third-party application like Collibra platform for Data governance. Build Automations and CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, AzureDevOps Server, Ansible to achieve Operational Excellence across different applications both third-party and custom build in-house applications. Automation using Shell/BASH and Python Scripting example: self-healing solution for applications and underlying infra, proactive monitoring with reactive design. Developing YAML playbooks in Ansible v2.10, v2.14 with Jinja2 usage, roles, azure collections, modules, vaults, plugins for automating the configuration and maintenance activities like DB backups, Package installations, patching/upgrade, configuration changes etc. Drive and Manage the Monitoring solutions with observability tool usage like splunk, ELK, Opera, Graphana for action oriented metric monitoring, Dashboards for critical KPIs , Proactive monitoring with Actions defined for Active-Active architecture. Architect solutions for highly reliable systems for public facing applications like setting up the DR environment with Active-Active design, Securing the traffic from end to end that involves the traffic from internet via Cloudflare CDN, VISA Public DNS to resources in perimeter zone like external F5 Load balancer routing traffic to nginx reverse proxy and to nginx app load-balancer and finally to IIS server in business zone. Designing the Active-Active, Active-Passive application infrastructure for Tier0, Tier1 and Tier2 applications with RTO within ~4 hours. Making sure SLA and SLO are met with precision. Work with multiple teams to deliver a certain project or complex tasks in a time constraint environment. Azure Cloud Platform for Managed identities and Governance, Implement and manage storage, deploy and manage compute resource, configure and manage virtual network, monitor and backup azure resource. Cloud resource provisioning via Ansible playbooks using the azcollections and plugins. Select appropriate Azure Infra services to design and deploy an application based on given requirements. Containerize applications using Docker and Kubernetes Provide an escalation point for my team for technical, personal and workload issues. Create strategies for the team and align them with SMART goals for each team member and evaluate performance, Quarterly and Annually. Explore GenAI capabilities in making the knowledge sharing from KB articles easy for peers. Worked on AskWiki production and contributed during the GenAI hackathon. Additional Responsibilities: Migration Projects: Led successful migration projects, optimizing infrastructure costs, and improving scalability. Example: Denodo upgrades for 6.0/7.0/8.0 with improved architectures. Setting up the design-studio, scheduler, solution manager for deployment, data-catalog. Oracle Hyperion for 11.1.2.4/11.2.8/11.215 with Essbase 21c Automation Anywhere v11 and v360 Confluent Kafka Supported the RHEL 7 to RHEL 8 upgrades for these applications. Migrating the Visa University infrastrucuture from edge.visa.com to extranet.visa.com domain. Incident Management: Implemented robust incident management processes, reducing mean time to repair (MTTR) and improving service availability. Example: Using ServiceNow for Incident and change management. Ensuring golden rule of changes are followed for every production change. Developed the dashboard for team to keep an eye on the assigned tickets ensure zero SLA breach. Performance Optimization: Conducted performance optimization efforts, identifying and resolving bottlenecks to enhance system responsiveness and efficiency. Security Best Practices: Ensured adherence to security best practices, implementing measures to protect sensitive data and mitigate risks. Example: End to End SSL involving configuration changes for web server like nginx/apache and application servers like weblogic, IIS etc. Using strong ciphers LDAP authentication over SSL. Integrating Denodo and Automation Anywhere with VCS to ensure proper governance and versioning in bitbucket. Security finding remediation reported via Qualys scan, Pen-Test, security assessment by cybersecurity. Implementing SSO using Kerberos and ForgeRock as IDP Proactive certificate monitoring and renewals Vaulting the credentials using ansible vault, azure keyvault, ERPM etc.

10/2015 to 10/2016 Associate COGNIZANT INDIA － Bengaluru, IN Guaranteed high availability of application servers across production and development stages. Automated infrastructure and application processes using Shell, Python, and WLST for enhanced operational efficiency. Delivered full-spectrum infrastructure and application support, encompassing performance optimization, troubleshooting, and team knowledge sharing. Facilitated seamless application deployments utilizing scripts and the Kintana tool. Fine-tuned performance of WebLogic, Oracle Application Server, and SOA Suite to ensure peak application functionality.

07/2012 to 09/2015 Software Developer INFOGAIN INDIA PVT LIMITED － Noida, IN Delivered robust infrastructure support, encompassing server maintenance, performance tuning, and troubleshooting, across production and non-production environments. Orchestrated seamless deployments, conﬁgurations, and high- availability (HA) strategies for Oracle SOA Suite (11g), Oracle Service Bus (OSB), and Managed File Transfer (MFT) platforms. Enhanced operational efficiency by automating routine procedures with Shell and Python scripts, facilitating service setup, deployment processes, and team knowledge sharing.

Education and Training

Expected in 2025 MBA: Fintech BITS Pilani

06/2012 Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science KRISHNA INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY

Accomplishments

Awarded Challenge Coin for Ownership with high standards, Coach & Mentor and Simplifier in subsequent quarter.

Outstanding contributor award in consecutive financial year.

Certifications

Automation Anywhere Administrator Certification

Denodo Administrator Certification for Data Virtualization platform

Courses Completion for Docker, AZ-104 , AZ-900, CKA, Weblogic Administrator, SOA Admin etc.

Ansible Advanced Certification Program

Kubernetes Administration( CKA Certification Program )

Languages

English: First Language
